equipment.name: 焰骸筑城者的Hurag式
equipment.bonus: 2件套：火属性伤害提高10%。4件套：施放战技时，装备者灼烧状态下的敌人受到的伤害提高12%，持续2回合。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Fire DMG +10%. 4-piece: When using Skill, DMG dealt to Burn-afflicted enemies increases by 12% for 2 turns.
equipment.description: 火系持续伤害角色首选，适合虚无命途。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best for Fire DoT characters, suitable for Nihility path.

equipment.name: 停转的萨尔索图
equipment.bonus: 2件套：使装备者受到的伤害降低16%。4件套：当装备者对敌方目标施加弱点击破效果时，恢复10点能量。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: DMG taken -16%. 4-piece: Regain 10 Energy when breaking enemy Weakness.
equipment.description: 生存型遗器，适合坦克和辅助角色。
equipment.descriptionEn: Defensive relic set, suitable for tanks and supports.

equipment.name: 繁星璀璨的天才
equipment.bonus: 2件套：量子属性伤害提高10%。4件套：对处于量子属性弱点的敌方目标造成伤害时，无视其20%的防御力。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Quantum DMG +10%. 4-piece: When attacking enemies with Quantum weakness, ignore 20% of their DEF.
equipment.description: 量子系输出角色首选，无视防御效果优秀。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best for Quantum DPS, excellent DEF ignore effect.
